valueCreationScenarios.title: Longer-Stay Select-Service Capture
valueCreationScenarios.summary: TownePlace Suites fits owners chasing extended and longer stays with select-service efficiency when kitchenette suites and simplified public space match demand without Residence Inn upscale residential intensity.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Suburban Employment Node Suites
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Suburban job and medical nodes create TownePlace value when length-of-stay patterns support suite product. Owners should underwrite housekeeping cadence and parking against real project and relocation demand.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Efficient Conversion Into Longer Stay
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Conversions succeed when existing rooms can support kitchenettes and residential cues at select-service cost. Value erodes if sponsors force StudioRes midscale prototype logic or SpringHill short-stay suite assumptions.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Secondary Market Extended-Stay Play
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Secondary and tertiary markets can favor TownePlace when competitive suite supply is thin. Compare Element and Residence Inn only when product tier and wellness or upscale cues truly match those brands.

scenarios.title: Longer-Stay Select-Service Positioning
scenarios.summary: TownePlace Suites creates owner value when guests need kitchens and suite space with select-service operating economics—not Residence Inn upscale residential depth or StudioRes midscale new-build prototypes. Underwrite longer-stay demand honestly. CALA evidence is limited in the current pack, so keep geography labeled International Reference until steward-matched.

scenarios.title: Suburban And Secondary Market Suites
scenarios.summary: Owner value rises near employment, medical, and secondary-market corridors that generate multi-night stays. Diligence competitive suite supply and operating staffing before modeling affiliation lift. Do not reuse Residence Inn CALA examples as TownePlace proof. Keep TownePlace Suites by Marriott product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the longer-stay select-service TownePlace Suites brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

scenarios.title: Operating Efficiency After Affiliation
scenarios.summary: Bonvoy helps only when TownePlace housekeeping and suite maintenance stay select-service disciplined. Sequence systems and training for longer-stay rhythms, and keep SpringHill all-suite short-stay logic out of this file. Keep TownePlace Suites by Marriott product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the longer-stay select-service TownePlace Suites brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.
